svg.aria-label: Animated pipeline of the Brest Stroke Registry: once access is approved, CT and MRI exams are retrieved from the hospital PACS, anonymized, the right series is selected among many and converted to NIfTI; blood tests from two lab systems are extracted from the data lake, cleaned, harmonized to one name and unit per test, then merged; both are linked to the patient episode, giving one registry row per episode
